Callout.Name: Injured Horse on a Trail
Callout.Message: Horse down on a trail, rider with it.
Callout.Advisory: Rider unhurt, animal unable to stand.

Script.Line: She is down at the bridge and she will not get up.
The rider is sat with her. The rider is fine, the horse is not.
There is a vet coming from town. That is an hour away.

Lines.Approach: The horse is down and the rider is sitting with it. Neither of them is going anywhere fast.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
